### Fund entities and unresolved offshore form

Ophir Partners Master Fund Ltd, CIK 1555295, is identified in its 2012 Form D as a Cayman issuer. The related-person section lists Michael Edward Bleich as director; Michael Bleich signed as director on July 31, 2012, before the August 1 filing. The full-name entry and Ophir firm records support the professional link. These dates identify a disclosure and signature, not the full directorship period. [[SEC-D-0001555295-12-000002]] [[SEC-D-0001555295-12-000002-ROLES]] [[SEC-D-0001555295-12-000002-SIG]]

The March 2026 feeder Forms D name EntryPoint Capital as investment manager and EP Fund GP as general partner. Both appear under the form's Executive Officer and Promoter role fields, with those clarifications. The filed roles do not establish an individual directorship for Bleich in either feeder.
